newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Ukraine's Kuchma says Yeltsin "strong, powerful".
newsitem.headline: Ukraine's Kuchma says Yeltsin "strong, powerful".

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma met Russian President Boris Yeltsin for 30 minutes on Thursday and said afterwards that the Russian leader was in fine form ahead of heart surgery due next month.

"I saw the real Boris Yeltsin -- a strong powerful person who knows what he wants. And the thing he wants now is to have an operation as soon as possible so he can return to the political scene," Kuchma told a news conference.
Kuchma met Yeltsin in the Barvikha sanatorium outside Moscow where the Russian leader is preparing for the operation to improve the blood supply to his heart.
During the meeting the two leaders resolved the problems surrounding a protracted dispute over the Black Sea fleet, presidential spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky said.
The president, 65, had two heart attacks last year and some doctors say he may have had a third just before the second round of a presidential election last July.
He has looked stiff and tired in television appearances since then but Yastrzhembsky said on Thursday that doctors were completely satisfied with Yeltsin's condition.
